# Formulas

Every calculation the curriculum requires. Worked examples are in the Chapter 14 lessons and the calculation questions in the app.

## Acreage of an aliquot description.

640 ÷ (product of the denominators). Use AND to add separate parcels.

*Lesson L10-2*

## The percent triangle.

Part = Total × Rate; Total = Part ÷ Rate; Rate = Part ÷ Total.

*Lesson L14-1*

## Percentage change.

(New − Old) ÷ Old. The base is always the starting value.

*Lesson L14-1*

## Sale price needed to net the seller a given amount.

Price = (Net + fixed costs) ÷ (1 − commission rate). Never multiply the net by (1 + rate).

*Lesson L14-3*

## Recover the original cost from a sale price and profit %.

Cost = Sale ÷ (1 + profit%). For a loss: Cost = Sale ÷ (1 − loss%).

*Lesson L14-4*

## Loan-to-value ratio.

LTV = loan ÷ lesser of sale price or appraised value.

*Lesson L14-5*

## First month's interest on an amortized loan.

Balance × annual rate ÷ 12. Principal = payment − interest.

*Lesson L14-5*

## Deed stamps, note stamps, intangible tax — formulas and who customarily pays.

Deed: round price UP to $100 → ÷100 × $0.70 (seller). Note: round loan UP → ÷100 × $0.35 (buyer; new and assumed). Intangible: new loan × 0.002 (buyer).

*Lesson L14-6*

## Housing ratio and total obligations ratio.

Housing = PITI ÷ gross monthly income. Total = (PITI + recurring debts) ÷ gross monthly income. Course benchmarks: 28/36 conventional; 31/43 FHA.

*Lesson L12-3*

## IRV and how to build NOI.

Value = NOI ÷ cap rate. NOI = PGI − vacancy & collection loss − operating expenses (NOT debt service or depreciation).

*Lesson L16-4*

## GRM vs GIM.

GRM = price ÷ MONTHLY gross rent (1–4 units). GIM = price ÷ ANNUAL gross income.

*Lesson L16-4*

## Cost approach.

Value = land value + (cost new − accrued depreciation).

*Lesson L16-3*

## Property tax with homestead exemptions.

School tax = (assessed − 25,000) × school mills ÷ 1,000. Non-school = (assessed − 50,000*) × other mills ÷ 1,000. (*second exemption is up to $25,000, CPI-indexed since 2025.)

*Lesson L18-2*

## Cash flow and cap rate.

Cash flow = NOI − debt service. Cap rate = NOI ÷ price.

*Lesson L17-1*
